====================================================================================================
Fluid Mechanics & Kinematics:
- Herschel-Bulkley non-Newtonian apparent viscosity calculation with Rabinowitsch-Mooney correction.
- Generalized Metzner-Reed Reynolds number and Fanning friction factor estimation.
- Triplex pump volumetric displacement, slip factor compensation, and cavitation monitoring.
- Hydropneumatic pulsation dampener bladder nitrogen charge pressure supervision.

IF rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 > 0.05 THEN

    rSlurryVelocity := (rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 / 3600.0) / rPipeCrossSectionArea;
ELSE
    rSlurryVelocity := 0.001;
END_IF;

(* Nominal Newtonian Wall Shear Rate: gamma_dot_0 = 8 * v / D *)
rShearRateNominal := (8.0 * rSlurryVelocity) / rPipeDiameter_D;

(* Rabinowitsch-Mooney Correction for Pseudoplastic Power-Law Behavior: (3n + 1) / (4n) *)
IF rSlurryFlowBehavior_n > 0.15 AND rSlurryFlowBehavior_n < 1.50 THEN
    rRabinowitschMooneyCorrection := (3.0 * rSlurryFlowBehavior_n + 1.0) / (4.0 * rSlurryFlowBehavior_n);
ELSE
    rRabinowitschMooneyCorrection := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* True Non-Newtonian Wall Shear Rate *)
rWallShearRate := rShearRateNominal * rRabinowitschMooneyCorrection;

(* Herschel-Bulkley Apparent Dynamic Viscosity [cP]: eta = (tau_0 / gamma_dot) + K * (gamma_dot)^(n-1) *)
(* Note: 1 Pa.s = 1000 cP *)
IF rWallShearRate > 0.01 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := (rSlurryYieldStress_Tau0 / rWallShearRate); (* Yield stress component in Pa.s *)
    rTempCalc2 := rSlurryConsistency_K * EXPT(rWallShearRate, (rSlurryFlowBehavior_n - 1.0)); (* Consistency component *)
    rApparentViscosity_Calculated := (rTempCalc1 + rTempCalc2) * 1000.0; (* Convert to cP *)
ELSE
    rApparentViscosity_Calculated := 4500.0; (* Upper boundary at zero-shear gelation *)
END_IF;

(* Bound Apparent Viscosity to Prevent Extreme Numerical Instabilities *)
IF rApparentViscosity_Calculated < 15.0 THEN
    rApparentViscosity_Calculated := 15.0;
ELSIF rApparentViscosity_Calculated > 10000.0 THEN
    rApparentViscosity_Calculated := 10000.0;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00020000; (* Set Bit 17: Slurry Gelation Risk *)
END_IF;

(* Generalized Metzner-Reed Reynolds Number *)
IF rSlurryDensity_DT101 > 800.0 AND rSlurryVelocity > 0.005 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := rSlurryDensity_DT101 * EXPT(rPipeDiameter_D, rSlurryFlowBehavior_n) * EXPT(rSlurryVelocity, (2.0 - rSlurryFlowBehavior_n));
    rTempCalc2 := EXPT(8.0, (rSlurryFlowBehavior_n - 1.0)) * rSlurryConsistency_K * EXPT(rRabinowitschMooneyCorrection, rSlurryFlowBehavior_n);
    IF rTempCalc2 > 0.0001 THEN
        rGeneralizedReynoldsNumber := rTempCalc1 / rTempCalc2;
    ELSE
        rGeneralizedReynoldsNumber := 10.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rGeneralizedReynoldsNumber := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Fanning Friction Factor Evaluation *)
IF rGeneralizedReynoldsNumber < 2100.0 THEN
    (* Laminar Non-Newtonian Flow *)
    rFanningFrictionFactor := 16.0 / MAX(1.0, rGeneralizedReynoldsNumber);
ELSE
    (* Turbulent Slurry Flow: Blasius / Dodge-Metzner Approximation *)
    rFanningFrictionFactor := 0.0791 / EXPT(rGeneralizedReynoldsNumber, 0.25);
END_IF;

(* Pipeline Frictional Head Loss Across Reaction Core [bar] *)
(* Delta_P = (2 * f * L * rho * v^2) / (D) in Pascals; 1 bar = 100,000 Pa *)
rPipeFrictionalHeadLoss := (2.0 * rFanningFrictionFactor * rPipeLength_L * rSlurryDensity_DT101 * EXPT(rSlurryVelocity, 2.0)) / (rPipeDiameter_D * 100000.0);

(* Triplex Plunger Pump Kinematic Model *)
rPumpCrankSpeed_RPM := rSlurryPumpSpeedRef;
(* Plunger Swept Volume per Revolution: V_rev = 3 * (pi * D_plunger^2 / 4) * L_stroke *)
rTempCalc1 := 3.0 * (3.14159265 * EXPT(rPumpPistonDiameter, 2.0) / 4.0) * rPumpStrokeLength;
(* Theoretical Volumetric Capacity [m3/h] *)
rPumpTheoreticalDisplacement := rTempCalc1 * (rPumpCrankSpeed_RPM * 60.0);

(* High-Pressure Slip and Volumetric Efficiency Calculation *)
rTempCalc2 := rReactorPressure_Voted - rPumpSuctionPressure_PT100;

    rPumpVolumetricEfficiency := 0.95;

(* Triplex Suction Net Positive Suction Head Margin (NPSH) Supervision *)
(* NPSH_available = (P_suction - P_vapor) / (rho * g) * 10^5 [m] or in [bar]: P_suct - P_vap *)

(*

====================================================================================================
Optimization & Control Theory:
- Discrete-time Linear Time-Varying (LTV) State-Space model:
    x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k]
    y[k]   = C_d * x[k] + D_d * u[k]

    J = (x - x_ref)^T * Q * (x - x_ref) + Delta_u^T * R * Delta_u

(* Populate Current Deviation States from Process Measurements *)

    rTempCalc1 := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopIndex2 := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempCalc1 := rTempCalc1 + (A_Matrix[iLoopIndex1, iLoopIndex2] * x_StateVector[iLoopIndex2]);

    FOR iLoopIndex3 := 1 TO 4 DO

            FOR iLoopIndex1 := 1 TO 6 DO
                rTempCalc2 := x_PredictedState[iLoopIndex1] - x_StateReference[iLoopIndex1];
                rTempCalc1 := rTempCalc1 + (B_Matrix[iLoopIndex1, iLoopIndex3] * Q_WeightDiag[iLoopIndex1] * rTempCalc2);
            END_FOR;
            rTempCalc3 := u_ControlVector[iLoopIndex3] - u_PreviousControl[iLoopIndex3];
            u_ControlGradient[iLoopIndex3] := rTempCalc1 + (R_WeightDiag[iLoopIndex3] * rTempCalc3);

            u_ControlVector[iLoopIndex3] := u_ControlVector[iLoopIndex3] - (rMPC_GradientStepSize * u_ControlGradient[iLoopIndex3]);

ELSIF u_DeltaControl[1] < -rPumpSpeed_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[1] := u_PreviousControl[1] - rPumpSpeed_MaxSlew;
END_IF;

IF (iState = 50 OR iState = 55) THEN
    (* Map control output to pump speed reference *)
    rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := 650.0 + u_ControlVector[1];
    IF rSlurryPumpSpeedRef < rPumpSpeed_Min THEN
        rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := rPumpSpeed_Min;
    ELSIF rSlurryPumpSpeedRef > rPumpSpeed_Max THEN
        rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := rPumpSpeed_Max;
    END_IF;
    rSlurryPumpStrokeCmd := 100.0; (* Full mechanical displacement *)
END_IF;

(* Actuator 2: Utility Trim Steam Valve Slew & Saturation Mapping *)
u_DeltaControl[2] := u_ControlVector[2] - u_PreviousControl[2];
IF u_DeltaControl[2] > rSteamValve_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[2] := u_PreviousControl[2] + rSteamValve_MaxSlew;
ELSIF u_DeltaControl[2] < -rSteamValve_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[2] := u_PreviousControl[2] - rSteamValve_MaxSlew;
END_IF;

IF (iState = 50 OR iState = 55) THEN
    (* Base steam position modulates down if reaction is self-sustaining autothermal *)
    IF rAutothermalIndex >= 1.05 THEN
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := 4.0 + (0.35 * u_ControlVector[2]); (* Low trim pilot mode *)
    ELSE
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := 28.0 + u_ControlVector[2];
    END_IF;
    
    IF rTrimSteamValveCmd < rSteamValve_Min THEN
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := rSteamValve_Min;
    ELSIF rTrimSteamValveCmd > rSteamValve_Max THEN
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := rSteamValve_Max;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Actuator 3: Flash Stage 1 Choke Valve Slew & Saturation Mapping *)
u_DeltaControl[3] := u_ControlVector[3] - u_PreviousControl[3];
IF u_DeltaControl[3] > rFlashValve_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[3] := u_PreviousControl[3] + rFlashValve_MaxSlew;
ELSIF u_DeltaControl[3] < -rFlashValve_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[3] := u_PreviousControl[3] - rFlashValve_MaxSlew;
END_IF;

IF (iState = 50 OR iState = 55) THEN
    rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 42.0 + u_ControlVector[3];
    IF rFlashStage1ValveCmd < rFlashValve_Min THEN
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := rFlashValve_Min;
    ELSIF rFlashStage1ValveCmd > rFlashValve_Max THEN
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := rFlashValve_Max;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Actuator 4: WAO Sparging Air Valve Slew & Saturation Mapping *)
u_DeltaControl[4] := u_ControlVector[4] - u_PreviousControl[4];
IF u_DeltaControl[4] > rAirValve_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[4] := u_PreviousControl[4] + rAirValve_MaxSlew;
ELSIF u_DeltaControl[4] < -rAirValve_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[4] := u_PreviousControl[4] - rAirValve_MaxSlew;
END_IF;

IF (iState = 55) THEN
    rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := 35.0 + u_ControlVector[4];
    IF rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd < rAirValve_Min THEN
        rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := rAirValve_Min;
    ELSIF rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd > rAirValve_Max THEN
        rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := rAirValve_Max;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Store Control History for Next Discrete Cycle *)
FOR iLoopIndex3 := 1 TO 4 DO
    u_PreviousControl[iLoopIndex3] := u_ControlVector[iLoopIndex3];
END_FOR;
(*
====================================================================================================
MODULE 5: STEAM-ASSISTED HYDROCHAR FLASH DEPRESSURIZATION & MULTI-STAGE CHOKE
====================================================================================================
Process Mechanics:
- Controlled pressure letdown from 30.0 bar reactor core down to 8.0 bar (Stage 1 Knock-Out Drum)
  and 1.5 bar (Stage 2 Hydrochar Receiver).
- Flashing vapor fraction x_flash and superficial vapor disengagement velocity estimation.
- Souders-Brown critical entrainment velocity limits and ceramic choke trim cavitation index sigma.
- Cyclic anti-coking steam pulse injection to prevent valve throat plugging.
*)

(* Flashing Vapor Mass Fraction in Stage 1 Depressurization: x_v1 = (h_L,in - h_L,out) / h_LV *)
IF (rFlashStage1EnthalpyVaporOut - rFlashStage1EnthalpyLiquidOut) > 10.0 THEN
    rFlashStage1SteamFraction := (rFlashStage1EnthalpyLiquidIn - rFlashStage1EnthalpyLiquidOut) /
                                 (rFlashStage1EnthalpyVaporOut - rFlashStage1EnthalpyLiquidOut);
ELSE
    rFlashStage1SteamFraction := 0.125;
END_IF;

(* Bound Calculated Flash Vapor Fraction (nominal ~11.0% to 14.5%) *)
IF rFlashStage1SteamFraction < 0.05 THEN
    rFlashStage1SteamFraction := 0.05;
ELSIF rFlashStage1SteamFraction > 0.22 THEN
    rFlashStage1SteamFraction := 0.22;
END_IF;

(* Souders-Brown Maximum Allowable Vapor Disengagement Velocity: v_max = K_SB * sqrt((rho_L - rho_V) / rho_V) *)
IF rFlashStage1VaporDensity > 0.1 THEN
    rMaxAllowableVaporVelocity := rSoudersBrownCoefficient_KSB *
                                  SQRT((rFlashStage1LiquidDensity - rFlashStage1VaporDensity) / rFlashStage1VaporDensity);
ELSE
    rMaxAllowableVaporVelocity := 0.65;
END_IF;

(* Actual Superficial Vapor Velocity in Knock-Out Drum *)
(* Drum Cross-Sectional Area: A_drum = pi * D^2 / 4 *)
rTempCalc1 := 3.14159265 * EXPT(rFlashVesselVesselDiameter, 2.0) / 4.0;
IF rTempCalc1 > 0.1 AND rFlashStage1VaporDensity > 0.1 AND rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 > 0.1 THEN
    (* Mass flow of flashing steam: m_dot_steam = m_dot_slurry * x_flash *)
    rTempCalc2 := ((rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 * rSlurryDensity_DT101) / 3600.0) * rFlashStage1SteamFraction;
    rActualVaporVelocity := rTempCalc2 / (rFlashStage1VaporDensity * rTempCalc1);
ELSE
    rActualVaporVelocity := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Entrainment Velocity Supervision *)
IF rActualVaporVelocity > (0.85 * rMaxAllowableVaporVelocity) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00002000; (* Set Bit 13: Flash Entrainment Velocity Exceeded *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
    (* Throttle Stage 1 Valve to suppress foaming / slurry carryover into steam exhaust *)
    IF rFlashStage1ValveCmd > 10.0 THEN
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := rFlashStage1ValveCmd - 2.5;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Severe-Service Ceramic Valve Cavitation Vulnerability Index: sigma = (P_up - P_vap) / (P_up - P_down) *)
rTempCalc1 := rReactorPressure_Voted - rFlashStage1Pressure_PT501;
IF rTempCalc1 > 0.5 THEN
    rCavitationIndex_Sigma := (rReactorPressure_Voted - rTempCalc2) / rTempCalc1;
ELSE
    rCavitationIndex_Sigma := 2.5;
END_IF;

IF rCavitationIndex_Sigma < 1.15 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00001000; (* Set Bit 12: Valve Cavitation Choke Risk *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Secondary Flash Letdown Control (Stage 2: 8.0 bar -> 1.5 bar) *)
(* Modulate CV-202 to maintain intermediate Stage 1 drum pressure at 8.0 bar *)
IF rFlashStage1Pressure_PT501 > 8.20 THEN
    rFlashStage2ValveCmd := rFlashStage2ValveCmd + 1.2;
ELSIF rFlashStage1Pressure_PT501 < 7.80 THEN
    rFlashStage2ValveCmd := rFlashStage2ValveCmd - 1.2;
END_IF;

IF rFlashStage2ValveCmd < 0.0 THEN
    rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 0.0;
ELSIF rFlashStage2ValveCmd > 100.0 THEN
    rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* Periodic Anti-Coking Steam Purge Pulse Cycle: High-Pressure Steam Burst to Clear Nozzle *)
tSteamPurgePulseTimer(IN := NOT bSteamPurgePulseActive, PT := T#120S);
IF tSteamPurgePulseTimer.Q THEN
    bSteamPurgePulseActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF bSteamPurgePulseActive THEN
    (* Active steam purge sequence for 3.0 seconds *)
    tSubTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
    IF tSubTimer.Q THEN
        tSubTimer(IN := FALSE);
        bSteamPurgePulseActive := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(*
====================================================================================================
MODULE 6: WET AIR OXIDATION (WAO) & SOLUBLE COD DECOUPLING CONTROLLER
====================================================================================================
Reaction Engineering & Multivariable Decoupling:
- Wet Air Oxidation converts soluble refractory organic carbon (VFAs, phenols, aldehydes)
  into carbon dioxide and low molecular weight organic acids.
- Arrhenius oxidation kinetics and Henry's law dissolved oxygen mass transfer.
- Multivariable Decoupling Feedforward Compensator: Eliminates strong thermal cross-coupling
  between exothermic COD oxidation heat release and reactor core temperature.
- Headspace Off-Gas Safety Interlock: Combustible Lower Explosive Limit (LEL) and O2 monitoring.
*)

(* Oxygen Solubility via Henry's Law at 220 deg C: C*_O2 = H * P_O2 *)
(* Air comprises approx. 21.0% O2 by volume: P_O2 = 0.21 * P_compressed_air *)
IF rCompressedAirPressure_PT401 > 1.0 THEN
    rPartialPressure_O2 := 0.21 * rCompressedAirPressure_PT401;
    rDissolvedOxygenEquilibrium := rHenryLawConstant_O2 * rPartialPressure_O2 * 32000.0; (* in mg/L *)
ELSE
    rDissolvedOxygenEquilibrium := 0.5;
END_IF;

(* Temperature-Dependent WAO Oxidation Kinetic Rate: k_WAO = A0 * exp(-Ea / (R * T)) *)
rTempCalc1 := rReactorTemp_Voted + 273.15;
IF rTempCalc1 > 350.0 THEN
    rTempCalc2 := -rWAO_ActivationEnergy / (rUniversalGasConstant_R * rTempCalc1);
    IF rTempCalc2 > -35.0 THEN
        rTempCalc3 := rWAO_Arrhenius_A0 * EXP(rTempCalc2);
    ELSE
        rTempCalc3 := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTempCalc3 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Observer Estimate of Effluent Soluble COD [mg/L] *)
IF rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301 > 100.0 AND rSlurryResidenceTime_tau > 10.0 THEN
    (* First-order oxidation conversion with DO availability constraint *)
    rTempCalc4 := 1.0 + (rTempCalc3 * rSlurryResidenceTime_tau * MIN(1.0, (rDissolvedOxygen_DO401 / 5.0)));
    rEffluentCOD_Estimate := rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301 / rTempCalc4;
ELSE
    rEffluentCOD_Estimate := rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301;
END_IF;

(* Soluble COD Destruction Efficiency Rate [%] *)
IF rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301 > 50.0 THEN
    rCOD_DestructionRate := ((rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301 - rEffluentCOD_Estimate) / rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCOD_DestructionRate := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Multivariable Decoupling Feedforward Compensator *)
(* Oxidation of COD releases ~13.8 MJ/kg COD destroyed, creating thermal heat in the core *)
(* Decoupler cancels thermal interaction by trimming steam valve inversely to air flow *)
IF rSteamThermalDirectGain > 0.01 THEN
    rDecouplingCompensatorGain := -(rWAO_ThermalCrossCouplingGain / rSteamThermalDirectGain);
ELSE
    rDecouplingCompensatorGain := -0.65;
END_IF;

IF (iState = 55) THEN
    (* Apply feedforward trim to steam valve *)
    rTrimSteamValveCmd := rTrimSteamValveCmd + (rDecouplingCompensatorGain * (rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd - 35.0));
    IF rTrimSteamValveCmd < 0.0 THEN
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := 0.0;
    ELSIF rTrimSteamValveCmd > 100.0 THEN
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := 100.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Off-Gas Headspace Safety Interlocks (ISA-84 / IEC 61511 Safety Instrument) *)
IF rReactorHeadspaceLEL_AT403 > 25.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00004000; (* Set Bit 14: Headspace LEL High Warning *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
    (* Throttle technical air flow immediately *)
    rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := 0.0;
    rNitrogenInertingValveCmd := 50.0; (* Inject Nitrogen to dilute headspace *)
END_IF;

IF rReactorHeadspaceO2_AT402 > 4.50 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00008000; (* Set Bit 15: Headspace Oxygen High-High Trip *)
    bEmergencyTripped := TRUE;
    (* Immediate trip of compressed air supply *)
    rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := 0.0;
    rNitrogenInertingValveCmd := 100.0;
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;
(*
====================================================================================================
MODULE 7: HIERARCHICAL INDUSTRIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE
====================================================================================================
State Architecture:
- State 0:  STATE_COLD_IDLE (Cold uncommissioned standby)
- State 10: STATE_NITROGEN_INERTING_PURGE (Displace air with N2 until O2 < 0.5%)
- State 20: STATE_HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_TEST (DI water pressurized to 30.0 bar leak verification)
- State 30: STATE_AUX_STEAM_THERMAL_WARMUP (Controlled temperature ramp to 180.0 deg C at 2.5 C/min)
- State 40: STATE_SLURRY_FEED_RAMP (Transition from water to biosolids slurry feed)
- State 50: STATE_AUTOTHERMAL_STEADY_STATE (Full continuous HTC at 220 deg C, 30.0 bar, MPC active)
- State 55: STATE_WAO_COD_OPTIMIZATION (Oxygen sparging active, COD reduction decoupling active)
- State 60: STATE_REGENERATIVE_CIP_BACKPULSE (Online hydro-acoustic pulse to clear tube fouling)
- State 70: STATE_CONTROLLED_SLURRY_PURGE (Displace slurry with clean water before cooldown)
- State 80: STATE_FLASH_DEPRESSURIZATION_EMPTY (Multi-stage pressure letdown to atmospheric)
- State 90: STATE_EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_QUENCH (SIL-3 safety shutdown, cold deluge, isolation)
*)

iActiveStateID := iState;

CASE iState OF

    0: (* ================================================================== *)
       (* STATE 0: COLD UNCOMMISSIONED IDLE STANDBY                           *)
       (* ================================================================== *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bCIP_CycleActive := FALSE;
        
        rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := 0.0;
        rSlurryPumpStrokeCmd := 0.0;
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := 0.0;
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 0.0;
        rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 0.0;
        rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := 0.0;
        rQuenchCoolingValveCmd := 0.0;
        rNitrogenInertingValveCmd := 0.0;
        
        (* Permissive Check to Transition to Inerting *)
        IF bEnable AND bEmergencyStop AND NOT bEmergencyTripped THEN
            iSubState := 0;
            iState := 10; (* Proceed to Nitrogen Inerting *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* ================================================================= *)
        (* STATE 10: NITROGEN INERTING PRE-PURGE                             *)
        (* ================================================================= *)
        (* Displace all atmospheric oxygen from reactor core and flash vessels *)
        rNitrogenInertingValveCmd := 75.0;
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 35.0; (* Open downstream path to exhaust *)
        rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 50.0;
        
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#300S); (* Maximum 5-minute purge allocation *)
        
        (* Verify headspace oxygen concentration falls below 0.5% vol *)
        IF rReactorHeadspaceO2_AT402 < 0.50 THEN
            tSubTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15S); (* Dwell to ensure complete displacement *)
            IF tSubTimer.Q THEN
                tSubTimer(IN := FALSE);
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
                rNitrogenInertingValveCmd := 5.0; (* Low nitrogen blanket bias *)
                rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 0.0;
                rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 0.0;
                wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#0004; (* Set Bit 02: Inerting Complete *)
                iState := 20; (* Proceed to Hydraulic Pressure Test *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tSubTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;
        
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#01000000; (* Set Bit 24: Inerting Timeout *)
            bWarningActive := TRUE;
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* ================================================================= *)
        (* STATE 20: HYDRAULIC PRESSURE LEAK TEST (DI WATER TRIAL)           *)
        (* ================================================================= *)
        (* Pressurize system on clean DI flush water to 30.0 bar to verify seals *)
        rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := 250.0; (* Low pump speed on water feed *)
        rSlurryPumpStrokeCmd := 100.0;
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 0.0;  (* Closed to build hydraulic pressure *)
        rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 0.0;
        
        IF rReactorPressure_Voted >= 30.0 THEN
            rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := 0.0; (* Stop pump and hold pressure *)
            tSubTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#60S); (* 60-second pressure hold test *)
            
            IF tSubTimer.Q THEN
                tSubTimer(IN := FALSE);
                (* Verify pressure loss does not exceed 0.5 bar/min *)
                IF rReactorPressure_Voted >= 29.5 THEN
                    wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#0008; (* Set Bit 03: Pressure Test Passed *)
                    iState := 30; (* Proceed to Thermal Warmup *)
                ELSE
                    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00010000; (* Set Bit 16: Hydraulic Leakage *)
                    bWarningActive := TRUE;
                    iState := 0;
                END_IF;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tSubTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    30: (* ================================================================= *)
        (* STATE 30: AUXILIARY STEAM THERMAL WARMUP                          *)
        (* ================================================================= *)
        (* Circulate DI water and inject trim steam to ramp core to 180 deg C *)
        rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := 450.0; (* Circulation flow on water *)
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 22.0; (* Maintain 30 bar backpressure regulation *)
        
        (* Modulate trim steam to achieve steady 2.5 deg C/min warmup ramp *)
        IF rReactorTemp_Voted < 180.0 THEN
            rTrimSteamValveCmd := 65.0;
        ELSE
            rTrimSteamValveCmd := 25.0;
            wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#0010; (* Set Bit 04: Thermal Warmup Done *)
            iState := 40; (* Proceed to Slurry Feed Transition *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* ================================================================= *)
        (* STATE 40: BIOSOLIDS SLURRY INTRODUCTION & FEED RAMP               *)
        (* ================================================================= *)
        (* Switch 3-way feed valve from DI water to concentrated biosolids slurry *)
        (* Gradually ramp flowrate while monitoring torque and apparent viscosity *)
        wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#0020; (* Set Bit 05: Slurry Introduced *)
        
        IF rSlurryPumpSpeedRef < 650.0 THEN
            rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := rSlurryPumpSpeedRef + 2.0; (* Smooth acceleration *)
        END_IF;
        
        (* When core temperature exceeds 200 deg C and slurry flow is stable *)
        IF (rReactorTemp_Voted >= 200.0) AND (rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 > 4.5) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Transition to Autothermal Steady State *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* ================================================================= *)
        (* STATE 50: FULL AUTOTHERMAL HTC STEADY-STATE REACTION CORE         *)
        (* ================================================================= *)
        (* Operating Envelope: 220.0 deg C, 30.0 bar, MPC multivariable active *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#0040; (* Set Bit 06: Autothermal Active *)
        wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#0200; (* Set Bit 09: MPC Regulating *)
        wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#8000; (* Set Bit 15: Master System Ready *)
        
        (* Host SCADA or Operator may activate Wet Air Oxidation Sub-Loop *)
        IF (rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301 > 15000.0) AND (rTargetCOD_Reduction > 20.0) THEN
            iState := 55; (* Transition to WAO COD Optimization *)
        END_IF;
        
        (* Check if Operator requested Purge / Shutdown *)
        IF bPurgeInitiateRequest THEN
            iState := 70;
        END_IF;

    55: (* ================================================================= *)
        (* STATE 55: WET AIR OXIDATION (WAO) & COD DECOUPLING ACTIVE         *)
        (* ================================================================= *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#0080; (* Set Bit 07: WAO Loop Active *)
        
        (* If COD destruction achieves target and air is reduced *)
        IF rTargetCOD_Reduction < 5.0 THEN
            rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := 0.0;
            iState := 50; (* Return to Standard HTC *)
        END_IF;
        
        IF bPurgeInitiateRequest THEN
            iState := 70;
        END_IF;

    60: (* ================================================================= *)
        (* STATE 60: REGENERATIVE HEAT EXCHANGER ONLINE CIP BACKPULSE        *)
        (* ================================================================= *)
        (* Execute rapid hydraulic cavitation backpulse to dislodge tube cake *)
        bCIP_CycleActive := TRUE;
        wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#0800; (* Set Bit 11: CIP In Progress *)
        
        tCIP_BackpulseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
        IF tCIP_BackpulseTimer.Q THEN
            tCIP_BackpulseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iCIP_CycleStepCounter := iCIP_CycleStepCounter + 1;
            
            (* Rapid toggle of backpulse valve *)
            bBackpulseValveCommand := NOT bBackpulseValveCommand;
            
            IF iCIP_CycleStepCounter > 6 THEN (* 6 pulses executed *)
                iCIP_CycleStepCounter := 0;
                bCIP_CycleActive := FALSE;
                rFoulingResistance_Filt := 0.00025; (* Reset observed resistance after clean *)
                iState := 50; (* Return to Steady-State HTC *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    70: (* ================================================================= *)
        (* STATE 70: CONTROLLED SLURRY PURGE & THERMAL RAMPDOWN              *)
        (* ================================================================= *)
        (* Displace all carbonaceous slurry with DI water before cooling *)
        wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#1000; (* Set Bit 12: Purge In Progress *)
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := 0.0;
        rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := 0.0;
        
        tPurgeDisplacementTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#600S); (* 10-minute water displacement *)
        
        IF tPurgeDisplacementTimer.Q OR (rSlurryDensity_DT101 < 1010.0) THEN
            tPurgeDisplacementTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 80; (* Proceed to Depressurization *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* ================================================================= *)
        (* STATE 80: FLASH DEPRESSURIZATION & VESSEL EMPTY                   *)
        (* ================================================================= *)
        (* Controlled gradual depressurization of reaction loop to atmospheric *)
        wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#2000; (* Set Bit 13: Flash Active *)
        rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := 0.0;
        rSlurryPumpStrokeCmd := 0.0;
        
        IF rReactorPressure_Voted > 1.2 THEN
            rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 30.0;
            rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 40.0;
        ELSE
            rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 0.0;
            rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 0.0;
            iState := 0; (* System Empty and Depressurized -> Idle Standby *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* ================================================================= *)
        (* STATE 90: EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN & QUENCH DELUGE (SIL-3 TRIP)         *)
        (* ================================================================= *)
        (* Fail-Safe Emergency Core Isolation and Cold Demi-Water Injection *)
        bEmergencyTripped := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        
        rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := 0.0;
        rSlurryPumpStrokeCmd := 0.0;
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := 0.0;
        rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := 0.0;
        
        (* Modulate emergency deluge and nitrogen sweep *)
        rQuenchCoolingValveCmd := 100.0;
        rNitrogenInertingValveCmd := 100.0;
        
        (* Open flash valves to depressurize if not blocked by overpressure *)
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 50.0;
        rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 65.0;
        
        (* Operator Reset Permissive: Only allow reset when safe temperature & pressure restored *)
        IF bResetAlarms AND (rReactorPressure_Voted < 3.0) AND (rReactorTemp_Voted < 80.0) AND bEmergencyStop THEN
            bEmergencyTripped := FALSE;
            dwAlarmWord1 := 16#00000000;
            dwAlarmWord2 := 16#00000000;
            rQuenchCoolingValveCmd := 0.0;
            rNitrogenInertingValveCmd := 0.0;
            rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 0.0;
            rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 0.0;
            iState := 0; (* Return to Cold Idle Standby *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;
(*
====================================================================================================
MODULE 8: COMPREHENSIVE ALARM TREE, DIAGNOSTICS & STATUS WORD SYNTHESIS
====================================================================================================
ISA-18.2 Compliant Annunciation:
- Bitwise aggregation of process safety alarms and equipment diagnostics.
- Master System Ready and Global Fault Flag synthesis.
- Heartbeat watchdog pulse generation.
*)

(* Aggregate Master Operational Status Word *)
IF bEnable THEN wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#0001; END_IF;
IF NOT bEmergencyTripped AND (dwAlarmWord1 = 16#00000000) THEN
    wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#0002; (* System Healthy *)
END_IF;
IF rFoulingResistanceObserver > 0.00005 THEN
    wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#0100; (* Fouling Observer Active *)
END_IF;
IF bManualOverride THEN
    wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#4000; (* Maintenance Override *)
END_IF;

(* Master Warning and Alarm Flag Evaluation *)
bAlarmActive := (dwAlarmWord1 <> 16#00000000);
bWarningActive := bWarningActive OR (dwAlarmWord2 <> 16#00000000);

(* Operator Alarm Acknowledgment Logic *)
